user_clarification: User likes the look. Primary defect is lack of weight, impact and intensity; preserve painted texture/palette and judge impact silently at actual shot size.
scope: One new authored blast and connected dust, actual pose strip and short24fps proof. No variants, tracer expansion, camera shake or production integration.
reused_native_fixture: Read-only v006 proof camera/background/holdout and existing FX-only bloom helper. New separate native files under effects/painted_pose_v007.
material_palette: Same saturation0.15, value0.90 and tint[0.72,0.77,0.83] as preferred v003, retaining drawing grain rather than flattening all detail.
art_method: Built-in ImageGen:12 distinct new blast poses and6 dust poses, source PNG bytes preserved. One targeted atlas edit removed late warm cores. Baseline registration is measured; no animation of cel scale, rotation or position.
art_limit: Generated poses remain modeled washes; selected native keys and final timing must be reviewed rather than assuming likeness or impact from the atlas.
first_layout_repair: First full-size keyframes exposed oversize canvas and whole-shape hot exposure. Preserved first-layout native/PNGs; v007b corrects dimensions and confines HDR strength to bright ignition pixels.
production_reuse_gate: Existing project gate read and checker passes dcc-mcp-production-reuse/v1. Prior original project assets reused where appropriate; existing mature-cloud animation rejected for this missing shape capability. No acquisition or addon install.
rights: New original generated atlases and existing original project gouge/fixtures. No third-party paid assets or downloaded reference footage bundled.
research_limit: Parent read documentation/descriptions; embedded video playback was not verified. Used qualitative sourcing/trajectory/dust-layer principles, not slowed preview timing as physical measurement.
resource_policy: Background Blender only, two CPU threads, one effects render at a time; check and yield to other Blender workers before each frame. No shared UI used.
